description: This source file implements OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) parsing, verification, and request creation functions within the Chromium project's net/cert/pki namespace. It handles parsing OCSP responses, verifying signatures, matching certificate IDs, and generating OCSP requests and URLs.

classes.name: OCSPCertID
classes.description: Represents the OCSP Certificate Identifier, including hash algorithm, issuer name hash, issuer key hash, and serial number.

classes.name: OCSPSingleResponse
classes.description: Represents a single OCSP response for a certificate, including cert ID, status, update times, and extensions.

classes.name: OCSPResponseData
classes.description: Contains the response data from an OCSP response, including responder ID, produced time, and list of single responses.

classes.name: OCSPResponse
classes.description: Represents the full OCSP response, including response status, response data, and optional certificates.

classes.name: OCSPResponseData::ResponderID
classes.description: Represents the responder ID, which can be by name or by key hash.

methods.name: ParseOCSPCertID
methods.description: Parses raw TLV data to extract an OCSP CertID structure.

methods.name: ParseRevokedInfo
methods.description: Parses revoked certificate info from raw TLV data.

methods.name: ParseCertStatus
methods.description: Parses certificate status (good, revoked, unknown) from raw TLV data.

methods.name: AppendHashAsOctetString
methods.description: Computes hash of a value and appends it as an OCTET STRING to a CBB.

methods.name: ParseOCSPSingleResponse
methods.description: Parses a single OCSP response from raw TLV data.

methods.name: ParseResponderID
methods.description: Parses responder ID (name or key hash) from raw TLV data.

methods.name: ParseOCSPResponseData
methods.description: Parses OCSP response data from raw TLV.

methods.name: ParseBasicOCSPResponse
methods.description: Parses a BasicOCSPResponse structure from raw TLV.

methods.name: ParseOCSPResponse
methods.description: Parses the full OCSP response from raw TLV.

methods.name: VerifyHash
methods.description: Verifies that the hash of a value matches a given hash.

methods.name: GetSubjectPublicKeyBytes
methods.description: Extracts the subject public key bytes from a SubjectPublicKeyInfo TLV.

methods.name: CheckCertIDMatchesCertificate
methods.description: Checks if an OCSP CertID matches a given certificate and issuer certificate.

methods.name: OCSPParseCertificate
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded certificate into a ParsedCertificate object.

methods.name: CheckResponderIDMatchesCertificate
methods.description: Checks if a responder ID matches a given certificate.

methods.name: VerifyAuthorizedResponderCert
methods.description: Verifies that a responder certificate is authorized for OCSP signing by the issuer.

methods.name: VerifyOCSPResponseSignatureGivenCert
methods.description: Verifies the OCSP response signature using a given certificate.

methods.name: VerifyOCSPResponseSignature
methods.description: Verifies the OCSP response signature, either directly or via a delegated responder.

methods.name: ParseOCSPResponseDataExtensions
methods.description: Parses extensions in OCSP ResponseData, rejecting unhandled critical extensions.

methods.name: ParseOCSPSingleResponseExtensions
methods.description: Parses extensions in a SingleResponse, handling known extensions and rejecting unhandled critical ones.

methods.name: GetRevocationStatusForCert
methods.description: Determines the revocation status for a certificate based on OCSP responses.

methods.name: CheckOCSP
methods.description: Main function to check revocation status via OCSP response, verifying signature and response validity.

methods.name: CreateOCSPRequest
methods.description: Creates an OCSP request DER encoding for a certificate and issuer.

methods.name: CreateOCSPGetURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL for OCSP GET request with base64-encoded request data.
